title: Silver Historical Value Chart
source: Study of Ancient Roman Silver Coins (2023)
narration: This chart illustrates key statistics highlighting silver’s historical value and stability.  A study of ancient Roman coins shows the denarius’s value fluctuated by only 5% over 500 years, demonstrating its consistent worth.  Furthermore, a recent survey found that 62% of investors consider silver a safe haven asset.  These figures underscore silver’s enduring appeal as a reliable store of value throughout history.
